answer: Milestone bond: each identity locks 70 credits, paid back at milestones. An agent files an anchor milestone with a key-bound pigment seal. Each epoch it clears the next milestone toward a summit at epoch 12, or the bond decays 10 percent. A copied milestone burns the bond. The k-th fake pays 70 plus 30 per milestone; 1,000 fakes lock 70,000. An honest agent pays 70 once, recovered at the summit. A rented milestone fails: the seal cannot move.
